summary_en: This Nature Communications paper introduces an integrated two-photon and photoacoustic microscopy platform that combines optical calcium imaging with photoacoustic measurements of red-blood-cell oxygenation and flow at single-cell scale in awake mice. A transparent micro-ring resonator ultrasound sensor enables simultaneous optical and acoustic access and makes the work a direct acoustic-optical imaging contribution.

summary_en: The paper develops skull-conforming acoustic holographic lenses that physically encode patient-specific wavefront corrections for transcranial ultrasound. A subject-specific volumetric holography pipeline combines anatomy, acoustic properties, and target constraints, with simulations over 20 cases and ex-vivo human-skull measurements validating volumetric acoustic-field reconstruction.

summary_en: SH-SAS models a 3D synthetic-aperture-sonar scene as a complex, direction-dependent spherical-harmonic scattering field represented by a neural implicit function. It learns directly from raw 1-D ToF signals and improves 3D reconstruction over backprojection and isotropic neural volumetric baselines on simulated and real in-air and underwater SAS datasets.
